prose: Matt Presti returns to InnerVerse to discuss his new documentary, Dispelling Dimensional Madness: A Refutation of Gnosticism, Mythematics, and New Age Scientism. As one of the key thinkers responsible for restoring the legacy of illuminated physicist Walter Russell, Matt Presti is a powerful force for logic and knowledge, and in this episode we will put Simulation Theory and other such nonsense to the Sword (of truth).
ext: In the oversized extension, we cover Alice in Wonderland's criticism of imaginary math, ghosts and spirits, hypercubes and tesseracts, Ma'at and myth, the nature of time, and seeing God by playing with magnets.
